Register Individual.description: Register a new individual in the OpenG2P social registry via the G2P Connect-style REST API.

Register Group.description: Register a new household / group in the social registry.

Enrol Beneficiary in Program.description: Enrol an individual or group in a social protection program.

Create Payment Batch.description: Trigger payment batch creation for a program cycle (the batch then flows out via the G2P Bridge to Payment Hub EE).

API Request (Beta).description: Raw HTTP request against the OpenG2P REST API.
API Request (Beta).code:
// Make an arbitrary request.
request('/api/v1/registry/individual', { method: 'GET', query: { limit: 50 } });

Search Individuals.description: Search the registry for individuals matching demographic criteria.

Poll Recently Updated Beneficiaries.description: Cursor-style polling for changes in program membership.

Get Payment Status.description: Check the status of a payment as it flows back from the G2P Bridge.
